legend: LAB = production code on modelled engine types, compiled by MSVC in CI. SOURCE = text rule with a proven negative. BINARY = PE audit of the delivered DLL. HUMAN = only the user can confirm it on Windows/DX12.

LAB: the 26 impacts of P1/P2/P3/P4 parried one by one, each with its own new press and its own native clip, two press leads (w_fix03_chain)
six D1->D2 pairs: two native activations, input_new 2, native_starts 2, matched 2, posture 24 (w_fix03_chain)
the same pairs under the 0.12.2 gate reproduce the exact log arithmetic matched+gap_arms==cancelled and D2 unparried (w_fix03_chain)
P3 breaks exactly on its ninth parry; no earlier
P3-1: press on the contact tick or after it pays nothing; the window was not widened
ordinary block without press never parries (rearm_after_no_press, immobile_shield_parry)
Bokoblin and Black fury parry: inherited CP04/CP05/CP06/POST08 labs
A_parry.NOT_EXECUTED: the lazy layout check in post08_step (a parry that is the first contact with an E_OC) is source inspection only: mod.cpp is not compiled by the labs
A_parry.HUMAN: physical timing of R+B on each impact; a Bokoblin parry as the very first contact of a session

LAB: 12 angles around a guarding actor with shield and body hit in one pass: covered = HP 0, +5 once, no rebound; uncovered = HP loss, no credit (w_fix03_shield)
a shield held out to the side never covers past +-112.5 deg
guard turns toward Link at most 0x800 per tick, never a snap; the body is protected only once the shield faces him
own parry +0, Link +25, native rebound; counter 50/50; multi Lizalfos (inherited w_shield_rebound, w_counter, w_multi)
B_shield.HUMAN: real shield pose: the BCK animation was not read, the lab models two arm positions; LIZ_SHIELD event=CONTACT logs the real geometry

LAB: same emitter instances of the native hit mark; colour fields only; alpha unchanged; first drawn frame fully orange (w_fix03_fx)
blocks keep the resource colours; a reverted preview returns to them
two callbacks of one contact: one record; two enemies: two records; scene change and shutdown leave no pointer or callback
C_spark.SOURCE: a new emitter or any shared resource write is rejected (lft03 negatives)
C_spark.HUMAN: the colour actually seen. If the blue lived in the HITNG texture pixels, the change would be partial; the resource was not read

D_audio.LAB: one playback pitched x1.12 per parry contact, same call, blocks untouched, reverted preview restores the pitch (w_fix03_fx)
D_audio.NOT_EXECUTED: other hook orders on the five new FX hooks and the presence of other mods: w_plugin_order does not include them; they stay for the A/B run
D_audio.HUMAN: the pitch actually heard; the log distinguishes an applied pitch from real listening only by NATIVE_AUDIO_PITCHED, not by ear

E_lockon.LAB: option default ON, ConfigService round trip, UI binding and label; press locks, release keeps, second press releases and hides; one change per flick with hysteresis; no candidate; lost target; NPC, wolf, horse, event; camera side; OFF writes nothing (lft03_lab, w_fix03_lockon)
E_lockon.HUMAN: real pad mapping, stick feel, camera, restart persistence with the real host, coexistence of R+B and the lock button

F_regressions.LAB: LIZ_RHYTHM byte-identical to 0.12.2; 370 HP, 6/12/30/5/25, +0, regen, A/B/C, 45/80, 80%, counter, breaks, x1.5, Helm, HUD, Black fury, manual R+B
F_regressions.SOURCE: cp04/cp05/cp06 combo cores unchanged since c242770 (empty diff); all frozen constants pinned by ci/liz_audit.py
F_regressions.HUMAN: other mods, p50/p95/p99, FPS, pause/resume and SHUTDOWN in the real game

G_security.BINARY: PE_AUDIT_PASS, 86 reviewed game imports; 5 new writers each bounded to its own stores (FIX03_PE_SCOPE_PASS); bounded encoding scan, not a proof of every memory effect
G_security.SOURCE: offsets pinned by static_assert against the SDK headers; offsets also read from the 2.0.3 EXE import library
G_security.LAB: reentrancy of callbacks, install all-or-nothing, teardown, stale records

guard rate.note: the chain gate rate==1 stays, because the Shield Attack rate stays x1.00. Those mutants remove the gate and change Link's clip rate. A mutant of a gate left rigid after a rate change does not apply: no rate changed

second fake emitter: lft03 source negative: dComIfGp_particle_set in the adapter
global pitch: lft03 source negative: movePitch outside its writer

invariants.patterns: P1 N-D-C, P2 N-N-N-D-N-C, P3 D-N-D-N-N-D, P4 C-C-N-D-C

limits: the labs run the production adapters on stub engine types with a transcription of the engine paths; they prove logic and call order, not the game
an individual parry per impact is demonstrated in the lab, not in the game
shield pose is a fitted model; commercial BCK data was not read
spark and audio cannot be read back; the HITNG texture was not read
the E_OC preview does not reproduce every condition of its commit: a mismatch is reverted and counted, but that first frame was already orange
child particles drawn before their parents could show one frame without recolour
P3 impact 1 keeps its 12 tick wind-up: frozen rhythm, window not widened
